premises.text: Marketers and product managers waste large spend because historical cohorts, segments, and A/B personalization cannot target each diverse user at the present moment
premises.evidence_span: none of that really targets you at this very moment in time

premises.text: A real-time machine learning platform personalizes every vertical, content type, touchpoint, and device for each user including cold-start users
premises.evidence_span: we built a platform for every single vertical, across all types of content, across every single touchpoint, and across all devices

premises.text: Integration is minutes not months: each user action is processed and returned to the site in about 125 milliseconds as a cohort of one
premises.evidence_span: it took minutes to integrate, not months

premises.text: SaaS pricing is usage-based so customers can easily add items and site areas to personalize
premises.evidence_span: our pricing is usage-based, which means that it's very easy for our customers to add new items and new parts of the site that they want to start personalizing

value.text: Websites and apps serve users the items they love to engage, buy, or share at the moment they care
value.evidence_span: give them the items they love, the items they want to buy, and the items they want to share

causal_links.evidence_span: Almost all of this is wasted
easy for our customers to add new items and new parts of the site

notes: Historical personalization failure folded as one pain. Cross-vertical/touchpoint/device claims folded into one platform mechanism; latency/integration speed kept with platform as delivery facet of real-time reaction. Trial uplift metrics excluded as traction. Singleton D1/D3 retained as separately revisable problem and pricing modules.
